abort.another_device: That address answers for a different sensor array than this entry was set up for.

error.wrong_model: That address answers Modbus, but not as the selected model.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the gateway the sensor is connected to.
data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port of the gateway. Most gateways use 502.
data_description.unit_id: The sensor's Modbus device address. Leave this at the default unless you have changed it on the sensor.

connection.description: Enter the address of the Modbus gateway your {model} is connected to. This is usually an RTU-over-TCP serial gateway, not the sensor speaking Modbus TCP natively.
connection.title: Connect to the sensor

reconfigure.description: Change where your {model} is reached. To add a different sensor, add another entry instead.
reconfigure.title: Change the sensor's address

data_description.model: The model printed on the sensor. These sensors do not report which model they are, so this cannot be detected.

user.description: Select the model of the sensor you want to add.
user.title: Select your sensor model

unexpected_device.message: The device at this address does not answer as a {model}: {error}

wrong_serial_number.message: The sensor at this address reports serial number {found}, but this entry was set up for {expected}.

wrong_device_at_runtime.title: {name} is now a different sensor
wrong_device_at_runtime.description: The address configured for {name} now answers as a different sensor array than this entry was set up for. Its entities are unavailable until you reconfigure this entry with the address of the original sensor, or point it at the new one.
